name: Laelia, the Blade Reforged
oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever Laelia attacks, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
Whenever one or more cards are put into exile from your library and/or your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on Laelia.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more cards are put into exile from your library and/or your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on Laelia.

needs.what: a batched zone-change trigger event that fires once per event when one or more of your cards are put into exile from your library and/or your graveyard (from_zones: library, graveyard; to exile), whatever caused the exile
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No trigger event watches cards moving into exile. leaves_graveyard covers only the graveyard half and fires for any destination, and nothing watches cards leaving the library; the trigger keys to_zones/from_zones are loader-restricted to leaves_battlefield destinations and spell_cast/land_played origins respectively
